title: errorsframe
summary: Error text reaches the screen, but through a different surface: SMSG_CAST_RESULT / loot errors route via ShowSpellError/ShowUiError into the center scrolling combat text (red, damage-styled). Program.UiErrorsParity.cs is only a parity-capture stub drawing a hardcoded 'You are too far away!' at the reference 512x60 TOP position - it is not a live message frame.

openItems.text: No live UIErrorsFrame: no fixed 512x60 top-anchored 3-line message area with newest-on-top insert, 5s hold and fade
No yellow UI_INFO_MESSAGE class (quest objective-progress toasts) - only red error-styled pushes exist
Parity stub is not wired to real errors (hardcoded message, shown only when armed)
